name: Boubyan Bank K.S.C
summary: Boubyan Bank K.S.C.P., together with its affiliated entities, delivers a comprehensive array of banking and financial solutions across a broad international footprint, serving clients in Kuwait, the wider Middle East and North Africa regions, Europe, the United Kingdom, and other global markets. The institution structures its operations into four key divisions: Consumer Banking, Corporate Banking, Investment Banking and International Operations, and Treasury. Its product portfolio encompasses a wide range of deposit options, including accounts for salaries, youth, savings, current transactions, and call deposits, alongside various fixed-term investments. Clients can access diverse financing solutions for needs such as home ownership and construction, vehicle purchases, furnishings, healthcare, and education, in addition to short-term loans and credit facilities secured by existing deposits. Trade finance mechanisms like letters of credit and guarantees are also available. Furthermore, the bank issues various payment cards, including credit, debit, and prepaid options. Boubyan Bank caters to individuals and institutions with consumer finance products, credit cards, and a full spectrum of deposit and general branch services. For its corporate and business clientele, it delivers Sharia-compliant products like Murabaha and Ijarah, specialized trade services, and other bespoke financial solutions, complemented by robust treasury services. The bank further extends its portfolio with an array of insurance coverages, encompassing motor, home, fire, general accident, car, marine and aviation risks, family takaful, and medical policies. Its investment activities are broad, covering direct investments, equity stakes in associate companies, and both domestic and global real estate ventures, along with comprehensive asset and wealth management services. The institution also engages in Islamic financing, notably Murabaha transactions with other financial institutions both locally and internationally, and actively manages its own funding requirements. Moreover, the bank extends brokerage services to institutional investors and affluent individuals. It embraces modern banking through mobile, online, and WhatsApp platforms, and also provides property management expertise. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait, Boubyan Bank K.S.C.P. operates under the ownership of National Bank of Kuwait S.A.K.P. as its subsidiary.
